drive.elevation_coverage.change_publication: A coverage change publishes the drive again even when ascent and descent are unchanged.
drive.elevation_coverage.numeric_semantics: ascent, ascent_m, descent and descent_m keep their 1.3.0 values and null semantics; coverage never changes them.

values.complete: The ascent and descent are Hub-derived and every stored position of the drive has an elevation that the ascent and descent calculation accepts (present and within -1000..=9000 m).
values.partial: The ascent and descent are numeric and Hub-derived, but at least one stored position lacks an elevation the calculation accepts. Missing sections can hide climbing or descending.
values.unknown: Coverage cannot be established: fewer than two usable elevations, totals copied from an imported source, or a drive whose coverage the Hub has not computed.

additive_policy: Clients ignore unknown object fields. A client that does not understand elevation_coverage treats every drive's coverage as unknown.
base: Every rule, route, schema, example and status set of hub-http-v1@1.3.0 applies unchanged, except the one additive drive member below.

negotiation.rule: The 1.4.0 drive items are served only when the request carries exactly one x-teslatlas-http-profile header whose value is exactly hub-http-v1@1.4.0. Without it, or with any other value or more than one value, the response body is the exact hub-http-v1@1.3.0 body.
